payload.reason: The evidence indicates a correlation between daytime activity and socioeconomic status (SEC), as people active during the day tend to use more standard language and have higher average incomes.

claims.text: People active during the daytime are more likely to use standard language, which correlates with higher socioeconomic status.
There is a significant correlation between the time of day individuals are active and their socioeconomic status, with daytime users having higher average incomes.
